## Description

What does this change do, and why?

## Related issue

Link the issue this addresses, if any (for example, `Fixes #12`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Content update (recipe, guidance, or wording)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test` passes (parser/source checks and executable recovery scenarios)
- [ ] Browser journeys checked for Fix a problem, Learn Git and Find a command

## Checklist

- [ ] No new dependencies or build steps added
- [ ] Pasted input still stays in the browser (no network transmission)
- [ ] Destructive commands include a "When to stop" gate, "Check first" checklist, and source citation
- [ ] Accessibility (WCAG AA, keyboard, screen reader) preserved
